description: TPOT on WavLM Large (G1 of the week plan): the feature set of pretrained19c_wavlm_large_so4 (wavlm_large_l20, per-speaker z-scores) with classical_tpot_1's search (100 generations of 100 pipelines, TPOT's default operators, every pipeline fitted on training and scored by UA on validation, at most 45 minutes per search), 4 parallel jobs per search. TPOT's search is random: this is seed 4 of 1 to 5, one sweep per seed so the five run side by side. How the results are read is fixed in RULE_night23.txt (analyses/night23_prep_20261022) before any run. Runs on CPUs.
